name: @react-anatomy/extension
description: Explore React composition in a 3D browser DevTools panel

scripts.test:extension: pnpm run build:extension && node scripts/check-layers.ts && node scripts/check-scene.ts && node scripts/check-background.ts && node scripts/check-rendering-fidelity.ts && node scripts/check-extension.ts && node scripts/check-props.ts && node scripts/check-deep-hierarchy.ts && node scripts/check-capture-limits.ts && node scripts/check-progressive-capture.ts && node scripts/check-layout-depth.ts
scripts.record:demo: pnpm run build:extension && node scripts/demo/build.ts && node scripts/demo/record.ts && node scripts/demo/render.ts
scripts.record:intro: pnpm run build:extension && node scripts/demo/build.ts && node scripts/intro/tts.ts && node scripts/intro/record.ts && node scripts/intro/compose.ts && node scripts/intro/render.ts && node scripts/intro/validate.ts && node scripts/intro/review.ts
scripts.record:intro:elevenlabs: pnpm run build:extension && node scripts/demo/build.ts && node scripts/intro/tts-elevenlabs.ts && node scripts/intro/record.ts && node scripts/intro/compose.ts && node scripts/intro/render.ts && node scripts/intro/validate.ts && node scripts/intro/review.ts
scripts.dev:firefox: pnpm run build:firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox --devtools
scripts.lint:firefox: pnpm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.test:firefox: pnpm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox && node scripts/check-firefox.ts
scripts.test:compatibility: pnpm run build:extension && pnpm run build:firefox && pnpm run build:compatibility && node scripts/compatibility/check.ts --browser=chrome && node scripts/compatibility/check.ts --browser=firefox
scripts.test:public-apps: pnpm run build:extension && pnpm run build:firefox && node scripts/compatibility/check.ts --browser=chrome --public && node scripts/compatibility/check.ts --browser=firefox --public
scripts.screenshot:readme: pnpm run build:extension && node scripts/demo/build.ts && node scripts/capture-readme.ts
